items.title: Millionaire Mega Mansion
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description: Millionaire Mega Mansion lets you survive in luxury. Enjoy tons of decorated rooms, pools, and other decorations!

items.title: Skyblock Hacker Tools
items.creator: Fall Studios
items.description:
You want to play skyblock but the classic weapons and tools are too boring for you? Welcome to Skyblock Hacker Tools!
Efficiency 10? Sharpness 9? Fortune 6? No problem, in this world you will find the best op tools you ever had!

+Single and multiplayer friendly
+By FALL Studios

items.title: City Detective
items.creator: Lifeboat
items.description:
Put the bad guys behind bars! You're the new detective for this chaotic city. Criminals are stealing fire trucks and robbing banks. The local precinct is stretched thin and needs your help to find the suspects, and lock them up for trial.
- 4 cases to test your investigation skills
- Find clues in a vast city
- Driveable police cars
- 5 skins

Book 'em!

items.title: One Block Tall Base
items.creator: Lifeboat
items.description:
Impress your friends with a tiny base that you can crawl into. The base is only one block tall, but it's packed with everything you need. Including:
- Secret entrances
- Farms
- Animal pens
- Enchanting room
- Brewing lab
- Mob grinders
- Storage
- Bedroom
- And more!

Also includes 4 vehicles to ride and 3 villages to explore.

items.title: Mushroom Monsters
items.creator: Sapphire Studios
items.description: Mushrooms are fighting back. They are no longer hiding in the shadows. Can you escape the cloud of spores and avoid the mushroom uprising?

items.title: Dream Friends
items.creator: Ready, Set, Block!
items.description:
Do you like to dress up in stylish clothes, then this pack is for you! Join the teens on their adventure! Explore the modern city with your new squad and discover even better trends to follow. When you've finished exploring, you can always hang out with your new friends and binge-watch anime or play video games. 

+ 1 free skin 
+ 12 skins 
+ By Ready, Set, Block!

items.title: Crazy Mob Teens
items.creator: Monster Egg Studios
items.description:
Mobs and teens? Crazy!

*12 crazy mob teens
*2 skins free

items.title: Halloween Horrors 2
items.creator: Dig Down Studios
items.description:
"Halloween Horrors" may have been scary but this sequel is downright terrifying. Nothing regarding these Halloweenish monsters is even close to natural. The pure sight of these creatures should be deemed criminal. Good luck with the nightmares.
-By Dig Down Studios

items.title: Scary Skeletons
items.creator: Dig Down Studios
items.description:
Skeletons are arguably at the core of every notable Halloween adventure. After all, who doesn’t enjoy a lifeless pile of bones assembled and animated by an evil spirit to appear life-like.
-By Dig Down Studios

items.title: Scary Creatures
items.creator: Dig Down Studios
items.description:
Some monsters know they are frightening and even take pride in their scaring tactics. These horrors hunt down their prey feasting on their fear at every turn. For them it's about the experience not the end result.
-By Dig Down Studios

items.title: Happy Halloween
items.creator: Dig Down Studios
items.description:
Make this Halloween an eventful one by gathering your friends together for a costume party they will never forget. Dress the part, make new friends, and impress some people with your holiday themed attire.
-By Dig Down Studios

items.title: Halloween Teens
items.creator: Dig Down Studios
items.description: Roam the Minecraft neighborhood trick-or-treating with your friends on Halloween in these ten costume options. You can even make it a challenge to see who can collect the most candy.

items.title: Creepy Creatures
items.creator: Dig Down Studios
items.description:
Be careful, there are some very creepy, wacky weirdos roaming around out there. Touch one and you might end up like Jack, all fuzzified. They might seem pleasant but that’s just an invitation to get close enough to you for them to attack.
-By Dig Down Studios

items.title: Fright
items.creator: Dig Down Studios
items.description:
Fright is fear like none other. From the dark corners of your room to the wooden planks creaking just outside your bedroom door, they are watching. Which one of these monsters frightens you the most?
-1 free
-By Dig Down Studios

items.title: Halloween Show
items.creator: Dig Down Studios
items.description:
When alone in the dark the last thing you would ever want to see is an extra pair of eyes. As soon as you realize your situation, it becomes a race to turn the lights on before the glowing eyes get any closer. These are the horrors in the dark. Are you capable of bearing the sight of them?
-By Dig Down Studios

items.title: Masks
items.creator: Dig Down Studios
items.description:
Some wear a mask to hide their identity, others wear a mask to add to their identity. Whether you are showing off or laying low, these mask skins will keep you stylin’.
-By Dig Down Studios

items.title: Holo 2
items.creator: Dig Down Studios
items.description: Holo takes hollow to the next level with shapes and patterns that leave your mind turning. Wear a skin that shows off the possibilities of complex geometry. With over six colors and twelve designs to choose from you are bound to find a skin you will love.

items.title: The Grid 2
items.creator: Dig Down Studios
items.description: The Grid has existed for millennia because of its interconnected nature. These lines are not just aesthetic stripes of light but rather structural anchors that hold the entirety of the grid together. They are the intergalactic thruway that carries the grid’s consciousness from one side of the universe to the other.

items.title: Artificial Intelligence
items.creator: Dig Down Studios
items.description: AI has finally taken over the world and has built itself robotic bodies. It can now manipulate the physical plane of existence pushing out everything that is human. It is a cybernetic hive mind, a singular consciousness, that cannot be trusted and it is your job to stop it.

items.title: Star Gamers
items.creator: Pickaxe Studios
items.description:
Who is ready to have fun? The Star Gamers are ready to become the best gamers in the world!

+ Colorful space themed skins
+ Great styles for everyone
+ By Pickaxe Studios

items.title: Neon Bots
items.creator: BBB Studios
items.description: Fight to protect the Neonverse with these robotic neon light hero skins!

items.title: Mobs in Neon
items.creator: Blockception
items.description:
Check out your favorite mobs in bright neon outfits! Look stylish in your dazzling clothing while being a creeper, cow, slime, or more! 

+ 12 unique outfits for you to choose from!
+ Bright and vivid colors, fun any time!
+ Custom skins for your favorite mobs!

items.title: Jarred
items.creator: Zombeanie
items.description:
Show off your love for food with these amazing jar skins! You can be a condiment, jam, or anything in between!
- 10 unique skins
- by SleepyK0

items.title: Yummy Derps
items.creator: Zombeanie
items.description:
Are you feeling hungry? Maybe a little silly? These delicious skins make it easy to play with your food!
- 10 unique skins
- by SleepyK0
